name: Balin

attributes.attribute: brother of Pelles, the Fisher King
caused the Fisher King's crippling wound

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Balin is an Arthurian hero, also called Balin le Sauvage. He plays a minor role in the legends of King Arthur. He was the brother of Pelles, the Fisher King. Balin struck the Dolorous Blow. That single strike was responsible for the Fisher King's crippling wound.

okr.objective: Describe Balin, the Arthurian knight whose Dolorous Blow crippled his brother the Fisher King.
key_results: Balin, known as Balin le Sauvage, is a minor Arthurian knight.
He was the brother of Pelles, the Fisher King.
The Dolorous Blow caused the Fisher King's crippling wound.
